name: Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Women Startup Scheme
description: Financial assistance scheme for women-led startups in Maharashtra.

eligibility_rules.reason: Women must hold at least 51% ownership in the startup.
The startup must have been operational for at least one year.
Annual turnover must be between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore.

name: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme
description: Maharashtra government credit-linked support programme for self-employment and enterprise creation.

eligibility_rules.reason: Applicant must satisfy the Maharashtra residency requirement.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
The standard upper age limit is 45 years.
Minimum educational qualification depends on the proposed project cost.

special_conditions: Women and other specified special categories receive age relaxation under the scheme.
Applicant should not have already received the specified government subsidy benefit.
Project must fall within permitted activities.

name: Swarnima
description: Low-interest financial assistance for women from the OBC category to support self-employment activities.

eligibility_rules.reason: The scheme is intended for female beneficiaries.
Applicant must belong to the Other Backward Class category.
Applicant must be domiciled in Maharashtra.
Applicant age must be between 18 and 50 years.
Family income must be within the applicable rural or urban limit.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme supporting new viable micro enterprises.

eligibility_rules.reason: Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
PMEGP primarily supports eligible new units.
Units that have already availed specified government subsidy are not eligible.

special_conditions: Only one person from one family is eligible for financial assistance for setting up projects under PMEGP.
Project activity must fall within permitted activities.
Certain trading activities are subject to scheme-specific restrictions.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: Collateral-free institutional credit for micro enterprises.

eligibility_rules.reason: The enterprise must fall within an eligible business activity.
PMMY provides institutional credit to micro enterprises.

special_conditions: Tarun Plus is available to entrepreneurs who have previously availed and successfully repaid a Tarun-category loan.
required_documents: Loan-specific documents requested by the lending institution
official_source: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
